## Change and purpose

Describe the problem and resulting behaviour. Link the issue where applicable.

## Validation

List checks actually run and their results. Explain anything blocked or untested.

## Risk and release

- [ ] No credentials or private/student data are included.
- [ ] Data sources, sample/unavailable states and security/privacy impacts are explained where relevant.
- [ ] Required CI passes; any dependency findings remain explicitly recorded.
- [ ] User-visible changes include suitable screenshots or reproduction steps where useful.

Describe deployment/rollback needs. Passing quality CI alone is not release approval.
